description: A caller has joined a queue and is waiting for an agent

Branches.description: The flows the caller's callflow goes on into when they leave the queue, by branch: _, exit_key, timeout, no_agents, no_agent_timeout. What the caller is resumed at on another callflow node if the action's own node has gone

Call.description: The caller's kapps_call JSON, including the control queue and Resource-Type

Caller-ID-Name.description: Caller ID name as the agent should see it

Caller-ID-Number.description: Caller ID number as the agent should see it

Callflow-Node.description: The kazoo node running the caller's callflow

Handoff-ID.description: Names this passage of the caller through the queue; the callflow action takes a member_continue carrying it and no other

Joined-Timestamp.description: When the caller entered the queue, in Gregorian seconds

Priority.description: Ordering ahead of lower priorities regardless of age

Shard-Count.description: The shard count the publisher addressed the member with
